validity.recommendation: Merge into / reconcile against P7544; treat the two rows as one Package 4 pipeline scope, not two pipes. Re-derive the 62 mi length (see spec note) and do not double-count the 750 MMcf/d capacity across both rows.
validity.researcher_notes: P7545 and P7544 are both named 'Marjan GOSP-4 Gas Pipeline', both cite the SAME single gem.wiki page (Marjan_GOSP-4_Gas_Pipelines) with the SAME three references, both have segment 'Subsea Pipelines', both Marjan field, and both carry the SAME capacity 750 MMcf/d and StartYear 2024. The underlying project is McDermott's Marjan Increment Program Package 4 EPCI contract (Saudi Aramco, awarded July 2019, ~$1.5B). The ONLY published pipeline figure for Package 4 is an aggregate: 'subsea trunk lines and in-field pipelines in excess of 330 miles (540 km)' (McDermott press release, reprinted by Offshore Energy 2019-07-10 and PRNewswire). That single 330-mile aggregate is what P7544 (len=330) records. There is no independent source describing a separate 62-mile Marjan gas pipeline; P7545's 62 mi appears to be a GEM-internal subdivision of the same Package 4 pipeline scope (or a mis-derivation from the cables figure — see spec). So P7545 is very likely a relabel/double-count of the same physical Package 4 pipe system already captured by P7544, not a distinct pipeline. Existence of the Package 4 infrastructure itself is solid: COOEC delivered the central Marjan oil-and-gas platform in Aug 2024 (worldoil / ecns), confirming the project is real and entering operation. The concern is duplication/granularity, not non-existence.

validity.recommendation: Verify the 62 mi length: no independent source documents a 62-mile Marjan gas pipeline. The Package 4 scope publishes 330 mi (540 km) of pipelines AND ~55 mi (90 km) of subsea CABLES; secondary summaries paraphrase the cables as '62 miles of subsea cables'. The 62 mi on P7545 likely originates from the cables figure, not from pipe. Re-source or drop.
validity.researcher_notes: McDermott's official Package 4 scope distinguishes two figures: '...subsea trunk lines and in-field pipelines in excess of 330 miles (540 km)' AND 'more than 55 miles (90 km) of subsea cables' (verified on offshore-energy.biz, expected tokens '330 miles' and '55 miles' both present; corroborated by PRNewswire). An Oil & Gas Middle East summary paraphrases this as 'over 300 miles of pipelines and 62 miles of subsea cables'. P7545's LengthKnown=62 mi matches the CABLES paraphrase, not any documented pipeline length — a likely attribute error. No independent source agrees with '62 miles' as a gas pipeline length. Capacity 750 MMcf/d traces to a single Arabic source (ahewar.org, aid=757740, '750' token verified) and is medium-confidence at best; applying the same 750 to both P7544 and P7545 compounds the double-count. Construction 2019 = the contract-award year (defensible). Status 'operating' is supported indirectly by the Aug-2024 COOEC platform delivery, but the row's own existing Status refs (ecns, offshore-energy) did NOT contain the token 'operating' in the worklist pre-check.

summary: P7545 is REAL (Marjan Package 4) but is a likely DUPLICATE/double-count of P7544 (same name, same single wiki page, same 3 refs, same 750 MMcf/d, same field, same 'Subsea Pipelines' segment); its 62 mi length matches the subsea-CABLES figure, not any documented gas pipeline length.
